study type: secondary analysis of a prospective cohort study
outcome: trial of labour after caesarean section (TOLAC) success
cohort: 194 parturients undergoing TOLAC with intrauterine tocodynamometry during labour
finding: Higher uterine contractile activity during labor was associated with successful trial of labor after caesarean section.
mod_finding: Women with successful vaginal birth had higher uterine contractile activity than those experiencing failed TOLAC or uterine rupture despite similar use of oxytocin.
